author: alvoron
title: smoke_ScaledAttnDynamic4D_GPU test crashes with SIGSEGV on iGPU
signature: smoke scaledattndynamic4d gpu scaledattnlayergputest comparewithref killed by signal sigsegv|Code Issue
root_cause: The single GPU functional test smoke_ScaledAttnDynamic4D_GPU/ScaledAttnLayerGPUTest.CompareWithRefs with specific parameters (4D dynamic inputs, causal=1, no attention mask, constant scale) crashed with SIGSEGV during the iGPU functional test run. This test is unrelated to the ARM CPU changes in PR #37053, which only modifies Intel CPU ARM transformation passes. The same test (smoke_ScaledAttnDynamic4D_GPU SIGSEGV) was previously seen on 2026-08-12 in PR #37369, indicating a pre-existing instability in the GPU ScaledDotProductAttention kernel for this specific 4D dynamic input configuration.
recommended_actions: Check if GPU ScaledAttnDynamic4D test SIGSEGV is a known issue in the GPU plugin tracker
The PR #37053 (ARM CPU transformations) is unrelated — do not block it for this GPU failure
Investigate the GPU SDPA kernel for 4D dynamic shapes with causal masking and constant scale but no attention mask
prevention_strategies: Add crash guard / signal handler in GPU SDPA tests for non-reproducible flaky SIGSEGV. Track GPU test stability in a separate issue.
historical_context: Same SIGSEGV pattern seen previously on 2026-08-12 in run 31565607750 (PR #37369). Pattern hash 588722c200316c0d, count now 2.
